name: Paul
description_ru: Кафе-пекарня французской сети Paul: выпечка и десерты, завтраки, салаты и горячие напитки; можно поесть на месте или забрать заказ с собой.
description_en: Café-bakery of the French Paul chain offering pastries and desserts, breakfasts, salads and hot drinks, to eat in or take away.
notes: Description is chain-level from paul.kz (site lists Almaty and Astana as cities but gives only the Almaty cafe address/schedule). Coordinates point to Kabanbay Batyr 62 (MEGA Silk Way); branch address and hours for Astana not confirmed by an allowed source.

name: Сквер в ЖК «Алтын Арна»
notes: Generic courtyard green space of a residential complex (Мәңгілік Ел 48); no sources found.

name: Тәп-Тәтті
description_ru: Магазин астанинской кондитерской сети «Тәп-тәтті», которая печёт с 2009 года: торты, пирожные, выпечка и десерты из собственных цехов; принимают заказы тортов к праздникам.
description_en: Shop of the Astana confectionery chain Täp-Tätti, baking since 2009: cakes, pastries, baked goods and desserts from its own workshops; cakes can be ordered for celebrations.
hours_note: на сайте указан единый график для всех магазинов сети (ежедневно 09:00–21:00); в OSM было 08:00–21:30
notes: Official site (SPA; texts read from its page bundle) lists the shop 'пр-т. Мангилик Ел, 51', ЖК Promenad Expo, phone +7 705 755 68 12 — matches OSM phone. Hours are chain-wide, not branch-specific.

name: Академия Танца ISTINA
description_ru: Частная академия танца и спорта для детей и взрослых: современная и уличная хореография, черлидинг, спорт на пилоне; ученики выступают на отчётных концертах и конкурсах.
description_en: Private dance and sport academy for children and adults: contemporary and street choreography, cheer sport and pole sport; students perform at showcase concerts and competitions.
notes: Official site lists only two branches: ул. Желтоксан 22/4 and ул. Кудайбердыулы 26. The OSM point sits at пр. Жеңіс 67 (ЖК Женис), which matches neither — the point may be an outdated location; no source found confirming a move/closure there.

name: Эфир
notes: No allowed source found for a cafe 'Эфир' near пр. Жеңіс 52 (Сарыарка district).

name: Арай саябағы
description_ru: Озеленённая территория на левом берегу рядом с парком «Жетысу». Парк «Арай» со скульптурами исторических деятелей был создан в 2007 году, а в 2018 году реконструирован и переименован в «Жетысу».
description_en: Green area on the Left Bank next to Jetisu Park. Arai Park, with sculptures of historical figures, was created in 2007 and in 2018 was rebuilt and renamed Jetisu Park.
notes: Wikipedia says Arai Park was renamed Jetisu Park in 2018 (coords 51.1358, 71.4386). OSM keeps a separate polygon 'Арай саябағы' just east of 'Жетісу саябағы'; whether it is still a distinct park is not verified — consider merging with Jetisu Park.

name: Абай
notes: Located at ул. Мамбетова 30. A non-allowed city guide (sxodim) describes a bookshop 'Дом книги «Абай»' at this address; no official/allowed source found, so nothing filled in. Category 'souvenir' may be wrong (likely a bookshop).

name: Vivamus
notes: No sources found for a cafe 'Vivamus' on ул. Амангельды Иманова.

name: Водные прогулки на теплоходах по реке Ишим
description_ru: Прогулки на речных трамвайчиках по Есилю (Ишиму), которые проводятся с 2008 года. Посадка на набережной у Дворца школьников; маршрут проходит вдоль центральной набережной с остановками у Центрального парка, в Самале и у памятника Кенесары.
description_en: River tram trips on the Yesil (Ishim), running since 2008. Boarding is on the embankment by the Palace of Schoolchildren; the route follows the central embankment with stops at Central Park, Samal and the Kenesary monument.
hours_note: сезонно: в 2026 году речные прогулки возобновились с 1 мая; расписание рейсов не найдено
notes: CityPass page: trip ~45 min, 6 stops; no prices/hours given. 2026 season start confirmed by NewTimes (25 Apr 2026). Seasonal — likely not running in winter (not verified).

name: Жастар сарайы алаңы
notes: Square in front of the Zhastar Palace (пр. Республики 34). No allowed source describing the square itself was found (only aggregators about the palace).

name: Renaissance
notes: Near ул. Кенесары 58. Only a non-allowed city guide (sxodim, 2021) mentions a painting studio 'Renaissance' at Кенесары 58 (master classes, art parties); no official/allowed source, current status unknown.

name: Slon coffee
notes: Small coffee shop on пр. Тұран; no official site or allowed source found.

name: Президент саябағы
description_ru: Один из крупнейших парков Астаны (около 83 га), открыт в 2007 году: искусственные ручьи, фонтаны и клумбы, центральный фонтан в форме птицы Самрук. В 2021 году реконструирован как часть единой зелёной зоны с набережной Есиля и парком «Триатлон».
description_en: One of Astana's largest parks (about 83 ha), opened in 2007, with artificial streams, fountains and flower beds and a central fountain shaped like the mythical Samruk bird. Rebuilt in 2021 as part of one green zone with the Yesil embankment and Triathlon Park.
hours_note: в августе 2026 года на части дорожек шёл ремонт
notes: NewTimes (28 Aug 2026) walked the park: entrance from ул. Байтурсынова opposite ЖК Highvill, open to the public, repairs in places. Wikipedia places the park 'around the Palace of Peace and Reconciliation' (coords 51.124, 71.458), but the OSM polygon lies further south-west and does not contain the Pyramid — location wording deliberately left out of the description.

name: Детская площадка (Сауран көшесі)
notes: Generic unnamed playground; nothing to verify.

name: Алматыкітап
description_ru: Книжный магазин издательства «Алматыкітап баспасы» (дом книги имени Ы. Алтынсарина); издательство работает с 1999 года и выпускает в том числе школьные учебники.
description_en: Bookshop of the Almatykitap publishing house (Ybyrai Altynsarin House of Books); the publisher has operated since 1999 and its output includes school textbooks.
notes: Official store list gives the Astana shop as 'Кабанбай батыра 38/2', phone +7 776 422 57 23 (matches OSM phone and hours); OSM reverse-geocodes the point to Сығанақ 10/4 — likely the same corner building. Publisher active since 1999. Category 'souvenir' should be 'books'.

name: Galleria
description_ru: Кафе-ресторан Galleria caffe в торгово-развлекательном центре «Керуен» на ул. Достык, 9.
description_en: Galleria caffe, a café-restaurant inside the Keruen shopping and entertainment centre at 9 Dostyk Street.
notes: Listed on the Keruen mall site, but that site looks unmaintained (latest promo dated Dec 2020), so current operation is not confirmed; no branch hours given.

name: Арман 3D
description_ru: Кинотеатр сети «Арман» (Arman 3D): показы новых фильмов, билеты с выбором мест в зале продаются онлайн на сайте сети.
description_en: Cinema of the Arman chain (Arman 3D) showing new releases; tickets with seat selection are sold online on the chain's website.
notes: Official site is a JS ticketing app (Kinoplan) — only the title/meta could be read; branch page arman3d.kz/61 exists. Non-allowed guides place it on the 3rd floor of the Asia Park mall, пр. Кабанбай батыра 21 (OSM point matches Kabanbay Batyr 21). Hours not verified.

name: Flex office
notes: Coworking on ул. Қайым Мұхамедханов; no official site or allowed source found.

name: Tutti Frutti Frozen Yogurt
notes: Address пр. Туран 37 = Khan Shatyr. The current official Khan Shatyr food-court list (https://khanshatyr.com/food-court) has no Tutti Frutti — its frozen-yogurt kiosk is 'Summer love frozen yogurt' — so this POI is probably outdated, but no source explicitly states closure. Listed website cafeyagusha.com does not resolve.

name: NIS Centre of Excellence
description_ru: Центр педагогического мастерства (Centre of Excellence) — организация дополнительного образования, которая проводит курсы повышения квалификации для учителей и руководителей школ; это не публичная библиотека.
description_en: The Centre of Excellence is a continuing-education organisation that runs professional development courses for teachers and school leaders; it is not a public library.
notes: Overture POI ('Turkestan 2 Block A', category library). The official site cpm.kz gives the address ул. Хусейн бин Талал 21/1 and no library; this point on пр. Кабанбай батыра may be an office or outdated. Not a visitor attraction — consider excluding.

name: Михай Эминеску
description_ru: Бюст румынского поэта Михая Эминеску, открытый в 2021 году; в это же время в Бухаресте открыли сквер «Казахстан» — в знак дружбы двух стран.
description_en: Bust of the Romanian poet Mihai Eminescu, unveiled in 2021 at the same time as a 'Kazakhstan' square opened in Bucharest, as a sign of friendship between the two countries.
notes: Forbes.kz (11 Sep 2021) reports the unveiling in Nur-Sultan with the Esil district akim present, but gives no exact location; the OSM point is in the GreenLine area (ул. ЕК-33).

name: Ozyurt
notes: Located within the Khan Shatyr building outline. Non-allowed guides describe Ozyurt as a Turkish restaurant chain from Almaty; it is not in the current official Khan Shatyr cafe/food-court lists (https://khanshatyr.com/food-court), so it may have closed — no explicit closure source.

name: Green Mall
description_ru: Торгово-развлекательный центр на ул. Сыганак: магазины, кафе и рестораны (в том числе фуд-холл The Torium), книжный Marwin, фитнес-клуб и стоматология.
description_en: Shopping and entertainment centre on Syganak Street with shops, cafés and restaurants (including The Torium food hall), a Marwin bookshop, a fitness club and a dental clinic.
hours_note: часы ТРЦ и паркинга; отдельные арендаторы работают по своему графику (например, фитнес-клуб 07:00–00:00)
notes: Official site lists address ул. Сыганак 17Б НП13 (OSM: 17П), parking for 100 cars, ~30,800 m² leasable area. Site footer says © 2021, so hours may be dated.

name: Master Coffee
notes: Master Coffee is a local Astana coffee chain (per non-allowed guides, since 2014), but no official site was found and no source confirms a branch on ул. Мұхамедханов.

name: Намазхана
notes: Prayer room mapped inside the Khan Shatyr building outline; no source mentions it (not in the official Khan Shatyr services list).
